name: Tri-plane to Gaussian Splatting Decoder
definition: A decoder network that maps tri-plane features from pre-trained 3D-aware GANs into explicit 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, enabling real-time rendering, latent interpolation, and GAN editing/inversion.
summary: The Tri-plane to Gaussian Splatting Decoder converts 3D-aware GAN features into explicit 3D Gaussian scenes for real-time rendering, eliminating viewpoint artifacts by producing fixed 3D scenes.
